\chapter{Results}
\label{ch:results}

Over 94 days the calibrated sensors stayed within four percentage points of
the oven-dried samples. Readings drifted during the first week while the soil
settled around the probes, then stayed stable.

\begin{remark}
One node failed after a storm flooded its enclosure. Its data are excluded.
\end{remark}

Watering only when the 30-centimetre reading fell below the threshold used
about a fifth less water than the fixed schedule, with no visible effect on
the crop.
